manual.reason: The path-validation leg of POST /api/projects/<name>/open-in-app has no named automated test; the browser contract test stubs that endpoint and therefore cannot assert the refusal.
manual.steps: Call POST /api/projects/<name>/open-in-app with a destination path outside the registered workspace (and with a traversal path) and read the response.
manual.expected: The endpoint refuses with an explicit error and no application is launched.
